image_description: A hammerhead shark swimming in dark blue water, viewed from below and slightly to the front. The distinctive T-shaped cephalofoil (hammer head) is clearly visible with eyes at the tips. The ventral side (belly) is white/pale, while the dorsal side appears greyish. Pectoral fins are spread out, and the mouth is slightly open. A portion of another fish or shark tail is visible on the far left edge.
